title: Old Storefront Album Art
coreRelationships: The central photograph is framed by a larger, textured paper background.
Two pieces of torn masking tape appear to adhere the photograph to the background.
The main title text is positioned centrally above the photograph.
The artist's name and logo are positioned centrally below the photograph.
reuseFormula: Recreate a vintage sepia photograph of a rustic storefront, complete with an old sign. Place this photo on a distressed paper background, secured by torn masking tape. Overlay a geometric sans-serif title at the top and artist name with a custom logo at the bottom, maintaining the sepia color palette.
